caseName: McCrary v. Aladdin Radio Industries, Inc.
caseNameFull: McCrary v. Aladdin Radio Industries, Inc.
attorneys: Albert Williams, Cecil D. Bran--stetter and Jerome A. Cooper for petitioners. Dick L. Lansden and William Waller for respondents.
judges: Application, Black, Consideration, Motion, Ste, Took

opinions.text:
Motion to use record in No. 116, October Term, 1957, granted. Petition for writ of certio-rari to the Court of Appeals of Tennessee, Middle Section, denied.

Mr. Justice Black and Mr. Justice Ste-wart took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion and-application.
